#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

static double EPS = 1e-9;
static int INF = (int)1e9;
static long long LINF = 1e18;
static int MOD = (int)1e9 + 7;
static double PI = acos(-1);

int go(long long n) {
    if (n == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    long long k = 1;
    int cnt = 1;
    while (k * 10 + 1 < n) {
        k = k * 10 + 1;
        cnt++;
    }
    long long mod1 = n % k;
    int res1 = go(mod1) + (int)(n / k) * cnt;

    long long diff = (k * 10 + 1 - n) % k;
    int res2 = go(diff) + (cnt + 1) + (int)((k * 10 + 1 - n) / k) * cnt;

    return min(res1, res2);
}

void solve() {
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << go(n) << endl;
}

/* SegmentTree class */
class SegmentTree {
public:
    int maxn = 100010;
    long long st[4 * 100010];

    SegmentTree() {
        fill(st, st + 4 * maxn, 0);
    }

    void update(int node, int i, int L, int R, long long val) {
        if (i < L || i > R) return;
        if (L == R) { st[node] += val; return; }
        int mid = (L + R) >> 1;
        update(node << 1, i, L, mid, val);
        update((node << 1) + 1, i, mid + 1, R, val);
        st[node] = st[node << 1] + st[(node << 1) + 1];
    }

    long long query(int node, int l, int r, int L, int R) {
        if (l > R || r < L) return 0;
        if (l <= L && r >= R) return st[node];
        int mid = (L + R) >> 1;
        return query(node << 1, l, r, L, mid) + query((node << 1) + 1, l, r, mid + 1, R);
    }
};

/* Matrix class */
class Matrix {
public:
    static const int maxn = 2;
    int x[maxn][maxn] = { {0, 0}, {0, 0} };

    Matrix mul(const Matrix& A) {
        Matrix res;
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < maxn; j++) {
                long long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < maxn; k++) {
                    sum += (long long)x[i][k] * A.x[k][j];
                }
                res.x[i][j] = (int)(sum % MOD);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    Matrix pow(long long k) {
        Matrix res;
        // Initialize res as identity matrix
        res.x[0][0] = 1; res.x[0][1] = 0;
        res.x[1][0] = 0; res.x[1][1] = 1;
        Matrix T = *this;
        k--;
        while (k > 0) {
            if (k & 1) {
                res = res.mul(T);
            }
            T = T.mul(T);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

/* Pair class */
struct Pair {
    long long fi, se;
    Pair(long long fi, long long se) : fi(fi), se(se) {}

    bool operator<(const Pair& oth) const {
        if (fi > oth.fi) return false;
        if (fi < oth.fi) return true;
        if (se > oth.se) return false;
        if (se < oth.se) return true;
        return false;
    }

    int compareTo(const Pair& oth) const {
        if (fi > oth.fi) return 1;
        if (fi < oth.fi) return -1;
        if (se > oth.se) return 1;
        if (se < oth.se) return -1;
        return 0;
    }
};

/* gcd function */
long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    long long r;
    while (b != 0) {
        r = a % b;
        a = b;
        b = r;
    }
    return a;
}

/* lcm function */
long long lcm(long long a, long long b) {
    return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
}

/* fpow function */
long long fpow(long long n, long long k, int p) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (k > 0) {
        if (k & 1) {
            r = r * n % p;
        }
        n = n * n % p;
        k >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

/* FloorOfNthRoot function */
#include <gmp.h>
#include <gmpxx.h>

mpz_class FloorOfNthRoot(const mpz_class& x, int n) {
    if (n <= 0 || x < 0) {
        throw invalid_argument("Invalid input");
    }
    if (x == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        return x;
    }

    mpz_class a, b, mid, tmp;
    mpz_class n_mp(n);
    mpz_class n_minus_one = n_mp - 1;

    size_t bits = mpz_sizeinbase(x.get_mpz_t(), 2);
    mpz_class start = 1;
    start <<= (bits / n + 1); // initialize b with a bit longer

    mpz_class prev_b;
    do {
        prev_b = b;
        mpz_mul(tmp.get_mpz_t(), a.get_mpz_t(), n_minus_one.get_mpz_t()); // a * (n - 1)
        mpz_pow_ui(mid.get_mpz_t(), a.get_mpz_t(), n - 1);
        mpz_divexact(tmp.get_mpz_t(), x.get_mpz_t(), mid.get_mpz_t());
        mpz_mul(tmp.get_mpz_t(), tmp.get_mpz_t(), n_minus_one.get_mpz_t());
        mpz_add(mid.get_mpz_t(), tmp.get_mpz_t(), a.get_mpz_t());
        mpz_divexact(mid.get_mpz_t(), mid.get_mpz_t(), n_mp.get_mpz_t());
        b = mid;
        if (b < a) break;
        a = b;
    } while (b > prev_b);

    return a;
}

/* sqrt function (BigDecimal in Java) replaced with GMP's mpf_class */
#include <gmpxx.h>
mpf_class sqrt(const mpf_class& A, int SCALE) {
    mpf_class x0(0, SCALE);
    mpf_class x1(sqrt(A.get_d()), SCALE);
    while (x0 != x1) {
        x0 = x1;
        mpf_div(x1.get_mpf_t(), A.get_mpf_t(), x0.get_mpf_t());
        x1 += x0;
        x1 /= 2;
    }
    return x1;
}
